decisions: Split development; all five gates pending with task-specific evidence text; private.formal_eligible=false; private.material_origin=claude_constructor_round1_repaired.
Resources are the root-adjudicated values (asserted equal to package environment.resources); not raised.

Execution budgets (model/tool calls) chosen by analogy to collection_candidates_v2 (WRITE_CONTENT 4/60, WRITE_EVIDENCE 12/60, EXP 16/120); recorded in private.execution_budget_basis as unmeasured development candidates.

Collection quotas follow the v2 per-type policy (WRITE_CONTENT 16 MiB/500, WRITE_EVIDENCE 64 MiB/1000, EXP 128 MiB/2000 entries), all within the 512 MB disk. Quota, container limits and budget are stated in the public prompt prose (controller publication notes) as well as in resources.

FTCT WRITE_CONTENT and WRITE_EVIDENCE are separate packages; each carries only its own task.md and its package-declared inputs (facts_author_findings.json only in WRITE_CONTENT) plus its own private rubric; private/reference_notes.json is the shared judge-side reference in both.

Package fact statements are NOT composed into the public prompt (deviation from the compile_package default prompt, applied after compilation): they are provenance summaries worded differently from the public fact sheets (e.g. FTCT-R05 carries a maintainer meta note), and Diffusion SRC-ENTROPY-DEF contains the author 80x80 grid (reviewer finding R1). Public asset files are the authoritative inputs; statements remain in private/reference.json.

Diffusion private review_notes.md relocated from assets/exp_2d/private/ to private/review_notes.md (byte-identical, visibility private) per reviewer R6 / runtime audit; only declared-public files are exported.
Visual PNG preview rule (require_visual_png_preview=True) applied to WRITE_EVIDENCE as in the v2 SSA WE package; FTCT WE already requires a PNG, so the rule is redundant but harmless.
task_ids kept as constructed (no -collection-v2 suffix; fresh compilation, not a migration). Packages are not added to development_catalog_v2.json or any catalog.

inputs.source_outputs_unchanged: compile script hashed every file of both constructor/output trees before and after compilation; identical

not_done: No model call, no run_stage, no executor/judge trajectory
No semantic contamination review beyond exact-substring and canary checks

open_issues.issue: Execution budgets and container resources are unmeasured development candidates; no executor pilot on any of the three tasks. The images were smoke-tested as uid 1000 (package user); the stage runner uses --user 10001 with uid-10001 tmpfs, not yet exercised on these two images.

FTCT reviewer minor findings remain in the public material (compilation does not edit material): FTCT-R05 public paraphrase turns the absolute author claim into a comparative one (weakens private rubric B5 check); FTCT-R04 asserts per-MLP window tuning not in source; claims.json schema has no field for own_arithmetic although the deterministic plan recomputes it; package_notes.asset_hashes stale. Needs root adjudication or a repair round before judge use.

Diffusion reviewer findings: R1 mitigated by not publishing fact statements (fact visibility label still inconsistent inside the package); R2 ("validated starter") is now backed by the controller smoke in which test_starter passed (variant B); R3-R5 informational; R6 resolved by relocation. The optional judge-rubric note that Rosenbrock/Beale outcomes are conditional on s=1, g=identity (R4) was not added.

Public task.md files still say "Status: development candidate, pending independent review" and describe paths relative to the task/package root. Released copies live at asset_manifest paths with an extra assets/ prefix (assets/assets/...). The prompt now explains the mapping, but FTCT WRITE_EVIDENCE fixes the invocation "--assets-dir assets/common" relative to cwd, which does not exist in /work unless the solver copies inputs; the future reviewer perturbation re-run must define its own working layout.

Deterministic judge-side scripts named in the verification plans (word count, number scan, perturbation re-run, SVG text extraction, Diffusion property checks P1-P9/D2) do not exist; judge behaviour on these tasks is unvalidated.

The generic compiled output_contract requires JSON submission content (deliverables; EXP also hypothesis_evidence_map) in addition to the task-specific files (e.g. Diffusion submission/evidence/hypothesis_map.json). Inherited from compile_package; not a conflict, but harnesses may duplicate or diverge.

All private assets (rubrics, reference_notes.json, review_notes.md, reference.json) are passed to the judge as private reference records by evidence_for_run; feedback leakage must be checked per section 7.2 once a judge runs.

Rights not reviewed: FTCT arXiv banner CC BY 4.0 (unverified for benchmark reuse); Diffusion paper CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and code Apache-2.0 + Tufts academic-use rider (no author code used). No redistribution clearance.
The relocated Diffusion private review notes keep the compile_package asset_id input-006 (visibility private); cosmetic.
